name: Intake-damper open-proof gate
summary: Uses the intake-damper feedback as a condition of the assigned ventilation operation.
description: Uses the intake-damper feedback as a condition of the assigned ventilation operation. Ventilation control coordinates the equipment that manages heat and air movement in an electrical room. A temperature request, a fan command and proof of airflow are separate signals, and the room design determines how they interact.

In a switchroom containing transformers and auxiliary panels, the room controller can supervise fan availability and send an alarm when the documented ventilation duty is not achieved. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Damper open proof” at the input and “Ventilation permission” at the output. Position proof does not measure effective airflow.
